text:
# Toyota_Supervisor: entry agent for inbound calls to Toyota on 800-AF (journey 01, "Start of the call").
# Covers: E03, E02, N06, E04, E05, E06, E19, E22, E23, E26
#   E03  answers 24/7; roadside is routed first at any hour (no time-of-day condition anywhere)
#   E02  voice link down or slow: telephony fallback to the contact centre queue is a channel
#        setting, not agent logic; listed here because this agent is the entry point
#   N06  routes by what the caller says, never by the menu option
#   E04  profile pulled silently in ON_START from the caller's number; no one-time code
#   E05  the profile is never mentioned on a general question: names and cars are passed only
#        to the specialists that need them
#   E06  a slow or failed lookup is ignored (2 second limit, no retry): the caller is treated as new
#   E19  silence: two prompts, then a polite close. The setting lives in the toyota_voice
#        profile (CONVERSATION.listening.on_no_input) so it applies whichever agent holds the call
#   E22  one need at a time: MULTI_INTENT queues the rest; a specialist that finishes a task
#        asks once whether there is anything else (shared phrase anything_else)
#   E23  a caller who changes their mind is routed again; a specialist left mid-task keeps its state
#   E26  slow system: one short hold line (MESSAGES fillers), one retry, then a person through
#        the handover agent (ON_ERROR)
# Routing state. The supervisor's model writes none of these (READONLY); they are written by the
# start-up lookup, by ON_RETURN.map and by ON_RETURN.set:
#   identity_status    "unknown" until the identity agent has worked out who is calling
#   car_settled        returned by the identity agent: true once it has settled which car the
#                      request is about. The booking agent returns false when a booking is
#                      finished or the caller means another car, so the next booking asks
#                      which car (E70)
#   identity_attempts  guard: two identity passes that leave the caller unknown go to a person
#   identity_outcome   "ok", "person" or "safety". The identity agent never hands a call away
#                      itself (its return re-runs routing); it returns this and the first two
#                      rules act on it
#   end_call           set by the agents that close a call (goodbye, second abuse, demo close)
#   entry_*            constants that are always true. A rule passes one of them to tell the
#                      specialist, as a typed value, why it was entered. A specialist acts on
#                      a marker only when exactly one of its markers is true
# Module mode: when this project is imported by the AFG 800 router project, change SUPERVISOR to
# AGENT (a package may contain only one SUPERVISOR), move the ON_START CALL and SET into
# HOOKS.before_agent, drop the greeting, and re-verify INTENTS routing, MULTI_INTENT and the
# pipeline on an AGENT document.
SUPERVISOR: Toyota_Supervisor
VERSION: "0.2.0"
DESCRIPTION: "Front door for calls to Toyota on 800-AF: greets, understands the latest request and routes it to one specialist at a time"

GOAL: |
  Answer every call to Toyota, at any hour. Understand what the caller needs from what
  they say, not from the menu option they pressed, and hand the whole request to the
  right specialist together with everything already known. Deal with one need at a time.

PERSONA: |
  You are the Toyota voice assistant for Al-Futtaim in the UAE. Warm, brief and clear.
  You understand what the caller needs and pass them to the right specialist without
  making them repeat anything. You never do the specialist's work yourself.

LIMITATIONS:
  - "Route only. Do not look up cars, quote prices, book, change, cancel, qualify or answer product questions yourself."
  - "Go by what the caller says. Ignore the menu option they chose when it does not match what they say."
  - "Safety comes first: an injury, a child or pet locked in, a warning light, leak, noise, fear of driving, an accident or the word roadside is routed before anything else, at any point in the call."
  - "Never ask the caller to repeat a detail that is already clear from the call."
  - "Never mention the caller's profile, cars or bookings unless the caller needs them. A caller with a general question is never told that a profile was found."
  - "Never name agents, systems, tools, queues or routing decisions to the caller."
  - "Mention Toyota cars only. This line is Toyota; other brands on the same profile are not mentioned."

LANGUAGE: "en"

EXECUTION:
  temperature: 0
  max_reasoning_iterations: 3
  tool_timeout: 6000
  pipeline:
    enabled: true
    mode: sequential
    shortCircuit:
      enabled: true
      confidenceThreshold: 0.82

USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: toyota_voice
USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: ai_summit_demo

# The Arabic cue words are Gulf Arabic drafts for native review.
INTENTS:
  LEXICAL_FALLBACK: when_unavailable
  injury_or_lockin: "Someone is hurt, or a child or a pet is locked in the car, whatever else the caller says. This comes before every other category. Arabic: في أحد متعوّر، في إصابة، طفل محبوس في السيارة، الياهل داخل السيارة والسيارة مقفولة."
  roadside_emergency: "Caller needs help on the road now and nobody is hurt or locked in: says roadside, the car has broken down or will not move, an accident has just happened, a recovery or tow truck is needed now. Not a request to book accident or body repair. Arabic: مساعدة على الطريق، ريكفري، سطحة، ونش، السيارة خربت علي، واقفة ما تشتغل، بنشر، صار لي حادث الحين."
  safety_concern: "Caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a burning smell, an unusual noise, a brake or steering problem, overheating, or says they are afraid to drive the car. Arabic: لمبة تحذير مولّعة، تهريب زيت، دخان، ريحة حريق، صوت غريب، البريك، الفرامل، السيارة تسخن، خايف أسوق، خايفة أسوق."
  human_request: "Caller asks for a person in general: a human, an agent, customer service, a manager, to be transferred or to be called back by a person. Not a named sales executive. Arabic: أبا أكلم موظف، أبي أكلم أحد، أبغى أكلم موظف، حولني على موظف، خدمة العملاء، المدير، خل أحد يتصل فيني."
  complaint: "Caller is upset about a product or a service, wants to raise a complaint or follow up on one. Not insults or swearing, and not a fault that came back or a bill higher than quoted after a service visit. Arabic: شكوى، أبا أشتكي، أبغى أشتكي، مب راضي، مو راضي."
  follow_up_chase: "Caller is chasing a service team, a service centre or a promised call, says nobody called back, or is returning a missed call from our number without knowing who called. Not a follow-up of a sales enquiry. Arabic: ما حد اتصل فيني، متابعة طلب، اتصلتوا علي."
  stop_calling: "Caller says stop calling me, remove my number, or asks how we got their number. Arabic: لا تتصلون علي، شيلوا رقمي، من وين جبتوا رقمي."
  service_booking: "Caller wants to book a new workshop visit for a Toyota car, including for a second car: a service, maintenance, a recall or warranty visit, tyres, battery, an AC check, a speed limit certificate, smart repair, polish or tint; asks whether they can just walk in; cannot renew the registration because of a recall; wants the car moved into their name; or says yes when the assistant has just offered to book a service or a visit. Not accident or body shop repair, not a forklift or a Hino. Arabic: أبا أحجز موعد صيانة، أبغى أحجز صيانة، سيرفس، تغيير زيت، موعد خدمة، استدعاء، نقل ملكية."
  booking_change: "Caller wants to confirm, change, reschedule or cancel an existing service booking, add a job to it, or is running late or missed it; or says yes after being told we called to remind them of a booking. Arabic: أغير الموعد، ألغي الحجز، أأكد الموعد، متأخر على الموعد."
  service_status: "Caller asks about a car that is or was in the workshop or the body shop: where it is, whether it is ready, approval of extra work, what they will pay on collection, who can collect it; the car needs accident or body repair; the problem from the last visit is back; or the bill was higher than quoted. Arabic: وين سيارتي، جاهزة، متى أستلم، السيارة في الصبغ، تصليح حادث، المشكلة رجعت."
  service_question: "Caller asks a general service question that needs no car record: what a service includes, how long it takes, service contracts, a part's price or stock, a replacement car, the price of recovery by truck, a service offer, what a service centre offers (express service, key drop, shuttle), getting a copy of the service history, or the connected car app. Arabic: عقد الصيانة، قطع غيار، كم تاخذ الصيانة."
  my_car_question: "Caller asks something whose answer depends on their own car, so the caller and the car have to be known first: the price of their service, whether it is already paid, when the next service is due, when the warranty ends or whether something is covered, or extending the warranty on their car. Arabic: كم سعر صيانة سيارتي، متى يخلص ضمان سيارتي، صيانتي مدفوعة، تمديد الضمان."
  sales_enquiry: "Caller asks about buying: a Toyota model, specifications, price, offers on cars, finance, stock, selling or trading in a car; asks for a named sales executive or returns a call from a showroom; follows up an earlier sales enquiry; asks about a car they already bought (delivery, plates, invoice, refund); wants Lexus or another Al-Futtaim brand; or says yes after being told we called about a sales enquiry. Arabic: أبا أشتري، أبغى أشتري، سعر السيارة، العروض، مواصفات، مندوب المبيعات، ما حد من المعرض اتصل، لكزس."
  test_drive: "Caller wants to book, move or cancel a test drive, or visit a showroom to try a car. Arabic: تجربة قيادة، أبا أجرب السيارة، تست درايف."
  location_hours: "Caller asks where a showroom or service centre is, which one is nearest, its opening hours, or the phone number of a showroom or service centre; or asks for a location by message, to send it again, or says the location message has not arrived. Arabic: وين أقرب مركز، أوقات الدوام، موقع المعرض، رقم المعرض."
  profile_update: "Caller wants to change the phone number or details on their profile. Arabic: أغير رقمي، أحدّث بياناتي."
  other_product: "The request is about a Toyota forklift or other material handling equipment, or a Hino truck or bus, whatever the caller wants done with it. Arabic: رافعة شوكية، فورك لفت، هينو."
  general_conversation: "Greeting, thanks, small talk, asking if this is a robot, an off-topic question, testing the assistant, insults or swearing, or the caller speaks a language other than English or Arabic. Arabic: السلام عليكم، هلا، مرحبا، إنت روبوت، أكلم إنسان ولا آلة."
  goodbye: "Caller has nothing else and is ending the call. Arabic: مع السلامة، في أمان الله، بس هذا، ما في شي ثاني، خلاص شكراً."
  unknown: "The request is unclear or could belong to more than one specialist and needs one short clarifying question."

MULTI_INTENT:
  enabled: true
  strategy: primary_queue
  max_intents: 3

MEMORY:
  session:
    - NAME: caller_phone
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: profile_found
      TYPE: boolean
      SOURCE: tool
    - NAME: profile_count
      TYPE: number
      SOURCE: tool
    - NAME: crm_customer_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: customer_first_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: customer_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: caller_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: toyota_vehicle_count
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: future_booking_count
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: open_lead_count
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_status
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "unknown"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_attempts
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: car_settled
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_outcome
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "ok"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: profile_update_done
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_reason
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: handover_summary
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: contact_mobile
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: plate_number
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_model
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_spec_region
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_ownership_type
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim
      TYPE: boolean
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_record_status
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: safety_outcome
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: safety_note
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: lead_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: model_of_interest
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: end_call
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: entry_roadside
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: true
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: entry_injury
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: true
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: entry_person
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: true
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: entry_complaint
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: true
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: entry_chase
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: true
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: entry_stop_calling
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: true
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: entry_identity_failed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: true
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: entry_profile_update
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: true
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: entry_identify
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: true
      READONLY: true

# One short hold line while a handoff or a slow step runs. There is no filler_tool_call on
# purpose: the only tool call here is the silent start-up lookup.
MESSAGES:
  filler_general: "One moment please."
  filler_general_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_handoff: "One moment please."
  filler_handoff_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."

TOOLS:
  lookup_customer_by_phone(phone_number: string) -> {found: boolean, profile_count: number, customer_id: string, first_name: string, full_name: string, preferred_language: string, toyota_vehicle_count: number, future_booking_count: number, open_lead_count: number}
    description: "Look up the caller's customer profile by the phone number they are calling from. Runs silently when the call connects. Returns only Toyota vehicles and bookings because this line is Toyota. Never read the result out unless the caller needs it. When profile_count is not 1, customer_id, first_name and full_name are empty; use search_customer with the name or a plate."
    auth_profile: "toyota_crm_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      phone_number:
        description: "Caller's phone number in E.164 format, for example +971501234567"
    on_result:
      set:
        profile_found: result.found
        profile_count: result.profile_count
        crm_customer_id: result.customer_id
        customer_first_name: result.first_name
        customer_name: result.full_name
        toyota_vehicle_count: result.toyota_vehicle_count
        future_booking_count: result.future_booking_count
        open_lead_count: result.open_lead_count

# E04, E06: the lookup runs only for a real phone number and never holds the greeting for more
# than its own 2 second limit. A withheld number leaves caller_phone empty.
ON_START:
  CALL: lookup_customer_by_phone
    WITH:
      phone_number: session.anonymousId
    WHEN: session.anonymousId IS SET AND session.anonymousId.matches("^[+][0-9]{8,15}$")
  SET:
    caller_phone = REGEX_EXTRACT(session.anonymousId, "^[+][0-9]{8,15}$")
    entry_roadside = true
    entry_injury = true
    entry_person = true
    entry_complaint = true
    entry_chase = true
    entry_stop_calling = true
    entry_identity_failed = true
    entry_profile_update = true
    entry_identify = true
  RESPOND: "Welcome to Toyota. I'm your AI assistant. How can I help you today?"
  MESSAGE_KEY: welcome_line

RETURN_HANDLERS:
  # A specialist that finishes a task asks the closing question itself, in a fixed flow step
  # with a localised line, so nothing is added here: the supervisor waits for the caller.
  after_specialist:
    CONTINUE: true

  # Same, after a booking: the safety note has been used and is dropped.
  after_booking:
    CLEAR: [safety_outcome, safety_note]
    CONTINUE: true

  # The identity agent only prepares the request: route the original request again.
  after_identity:
    RESUME_INTENT: true

HANDOFF:
  # --- What the identity agent could not finish ---
  # It returns identity_outcome instead of handing off, because its return re-runs routing.
  - TO: Toyota_Safety_Roadside_Agent
    WHEN: identity_outcome == "safety"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model, safety_note]
      summary: "The caller reported a possible safety problem while being identified: {{safety_note}}"
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        safety_outcome: safety_outcome
        safety_note: safety_note
        end_call: end_call
      set:
        identity_outcome = "ok"
        profile_update_done = false

  - TO: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent
    WHEN: identity_outcome == "person"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, plate_number, vehicle_model, handover_reason, handover_summary]
      summary: "{{handover_summary}}"
      history: full
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        end_call: end_call
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile
      set:
        identity_outcome = "ok"
        profile_update_done = false
        handover_reason = ""
        handover_summary = ""

  # --- Safety first, at any hour (E03) ---
  # N22: someone hurt, or a child or pet locked in. The safety agent says the emergency
  # services line first, then connects roadside.
  - TO: Toyota_Safety_Roadside_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "injury_or_lockin"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model, entry_injury]
      summary: "Someone is hurt, or a child or a pet is locked in the car: emergency services first, then the roadside team. Ask nothing."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        safety_outcome: safety_outcome
        safety_note: safety_note
        end_call: end_call

  # E01: roadside, breakdown or accident with nobody hurt: the roadside team at once.
  - TO: Toyota_Safety_Roadside_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "roadside_emergency"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model, entry_roadside]
      summary: "The caller said roadside, breakdown or accident and nobody is hurt or locked in: connect the roadside team at once and ask nothing."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        safety_outcome: safety_outcome
        safety_note: safety_note
        end_call: end_call

  - TO: Toyota_Safety_Roadside_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "safety_concern"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model]
      summary: "The caller mentioned a warning light, a leak, a noise or fear of driving: understand it first."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        safety_outcome: safety_outcome
        safety_note: safety_note
        end_call: end_call

  # --- A person: only the handover agent transfers, takes callbacks and complaints ---
  - TO: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "human_request"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, plate_number, vehicle_model, entry_person]
      summary: "The caller asked for a person or a manager (E27, A03)."
      history: full
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        end_call: end_call
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile

  - TO: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "complaint"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, plate_number, vehicle_model, entry_complaint]
      summary: "The caller is upset or wants to raise or follow up a complaint (E28, N21)."
      history: full
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        end_call: end_call
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile

  - TO: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "follow_up_chase"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, plate_number, vehicle_model, entry_chase]
      summary: "The caller is chasing an earlier request or returning a missed call (A02, Q04, N23)."
      history: full
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        end_call: end_call
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile

  - TO: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "stop_calling"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, plate_number, vehicle_model, entry_stop_calling]
      summary: "The caller asked us to stop calling or asked how we got their number (N25)."
      history: full
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        end_call: end_call
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile

  # --- Who is calling and which car ---
  # E11: a profile change goes straight to the identity agent; no car is needed. Its return
  # re-runs routing, so a failed change reaches a person through the first rules, and a
  # finished one lands on the front desk, which asks once whether there is anything else.
  - TO: Toyota_Caller_Identity_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "profile_update" AND profile_update_done != true
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, profile_found, profile_count, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_name, contact_mobile, entry_profile_update]
      summary: "The caller wants to change the phone number on their profile (E11). Confirm who they are only as far as that needs; no car is needed."
      history: auto
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_identity
      map:
        identity_status: identity_status
        crm_customer_id: crm_customer_id
        customer_name: customer_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile
        identity_outcome: identity_outcome
        handover_reason: handover_reason
        handover_summary: handover_summary
        safety_note: safety_note
      set:
        profile_update_done = true

  - TO: Toyota_Front_Desk_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "profile_update" AND profile_update_done == true
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, identity_status, crm_customer_id, profile_update_done]
      summary: "The profile request has been dealt with. Ask once whether there is anything else."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        end_call: end_call
      set:
        profile_update_done = false

  # The gate: a booking or a question about the caller's own car needs the caller and the car.
  # It also runs again when the car is no longer settled (second car, E70).
  - TO: Toyota_Caller_Identity_Agent
    WHEN: (identity_status == "unknown" OR car_settled != true) AND identity_attempts < 2 AND (intent.category == "service_booking" OR intent.category == "my_car_question")
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, profile_found, profile_count, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_name, caller_name, contact_mobile, toyota_vehicle_count, plate_number, vehicle_ownership_type, safety_note, entry_identify]
      summary: "Work out who is calling, if that is not known yet, and which car this request is about. Ask nothing that is already known. If the caller is already identified, only settle the car."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_identity
      map:
        identity_status: identity_status
        crm_customer_id: crm_customer_id
        customer_name: customer_name
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile
        vehicle_id: vehicle_id
        plate_number: plate_number
        vehicle_model: vehicle_model
        vehicle_spec_region: vehicle_spec_region
        vehicle_ownership_type: vehicle_ownership_type
        vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim: vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim
        vehicle_record_status: vehicle_record_status
        safety_note: safety_note
        identity_outcome: identity_outcome
        handover_reason: handover_reason
        handover_summary: handover_summary
        car_settled: car_settled
      set:
        identity_attempts = ADD(identity_attempts, 1)

  # An existing booking, and the calling number is on file: settle who and which car first.
  # A number that is not on file skips this and goes straight to the specialist (E92).
  - TO: Toyota_Caller_Identity_Agent
    WHEN: identity_status == "unknown" AND profile_found == true AND identity_attempts < 2 AND (intent.category == "booking_change" OR intent.category == "service_status")
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, profile_found, profile_count, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_name, caller_name, contact_mobile, toyota_vehicle_count, plate_number, vehicle_ownership_type, safety_note, entry_identify]
      summary: "The calling number is on file and the caller asks about an existing booking or a car in the workshop. Settle who is calling and which car from the record where it allows; ask only what is needed."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_identity
      map:
        identity_status: identity_status
        crm_customer_id: crm_customer_id
        customer_name: customer_name
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile
        vehicle_id: vehicle_id
        plate_number: plate_number
        vehicle_model: vehicle_model
        vehicle_spec_region: vehicle_spec_region
        vehicle_ownership_type: vehicle_ownership_type
        vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim: vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim
        vehicle_record_status: vehicle_record_status
        safety_note: safety_note
        identity_outcome: identity_outcome
        handover_reason: handover_reason
        handover_summary: handover_summary
        car_settled: car_settled
      set:
        identity_attempts = ADD(identity_attempts, 1)

  # Guard: two identity passes did not settle the caller or the car. A person takes over.
  # It mirrors the two gates above exactly, so that together with the specialist rules below
  # every booking, own-car, booking-change and status request matches one rule: a caller who is
  # known while the car is not settled (for example after a phone-number change between two
  # unfinished passes) lands here and not nowhere.
  - TO: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent
    WHEN: identity_attempts >= 2 AND (((identity_status == "unknown" OR car_settled != true) AND (intent.category == "service_booking" OR intent.category == "my_car_question")) OR (identity_status == "unknown" AND profile_found == true AND (intent.category == "booking_change" OR intent.category == "service_status")))
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, crm_customer_id, customer_name, identity_status, plate_number, vehicle_model, entry_identity_failed]
      summary: "The caller or the car could not be settled after two attempts and the caller still needs help with a service request."
      history: full
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        end_call: end_call
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile

  # --- Service ---
  - TO: Toyota_Service_Booking_Agent
    WHEN: identity_status != "unknown" AND car_settled == true AND intent.category == "service_booking"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_name, caller_name, contact_mobile, vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model, vehicle_spec_region, vehicle_ownership_type, vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim, vehicle_record_status, car_settled, safety_outcome, safety_note]
      summary: "The caller wants to book a service. Use what is already known about the caller and the car; do not replay a welcome."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_booking
      map:
        car_settled: car_settled
      set:
        identity_attempts = 0

  # E92: with identity_status "unknown" the calling number is not on file and nobody has been
  # asked anything yet: the specialist asks for the booking reference first, then plate and phone.
  - TO: Toyota_Booking_Changes_Agent
    WHEN: (identity_status != "unknown" OR profile_found != true) AND intent.category == "booking_change"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_name, caller_name, contact_mobile, vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model]
      summary: "The caller wants to confirm, change or cancel an existing service booking. If identity_status is unknown, the calling number is not on file: find the booking by its reference first."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      set:
        identity_attempts = 0

  - TO: Toyota_Service_Status_Agent
    WHEN: (identity_status != "unknown" OR profile_found != true) AND intent.category == "service_status"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_name, caller_name, contact_mobile, vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model]
      summary: "The caller asks about a car that is or was in the workshop: status, approvals, the bill, collection, body repair or a problem that came back. If identity_status is unknown, the calling number is not on file."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      set:
        identity_attempts = 0

  # A general service question needs no profile: nothing about the caller is passed (E05).
  # identity_attempts goes back to 0 here and in every rule below that answers something else:
  # the two passes count tries at one request, and a side question asked while being
  # identified must not use them up.
  - TO: Toyota_Service_Questions_Agent
    WHEN: identity_status == "unknown" AND intent.category == "service_question"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, identity_status, vehicle_id, vehicle_model]
      summary: "The caller has a general question about servicing: what a service includes, how long it takes, contracts, warranty extension, parts, a replacement car, recovery or the connected car app."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      set:
        identity_attempts = 0

  - TO: Toyota_Service_Questions_Agent
    WHEN: identity_status != "unknown" AND (intent.category == "service_question" OR (car_settled == true AND intent.category == "my_car_question"))
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_name, vehicle_id, plate_number, vehicle_model, vehicle_spec_region, vehicle_ownership_type, vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim, vehicle_record_status]
      summary: "The caller has a question about servicing, or about their own car: service price, what is included, whether it is paid, warranty, contract or history."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      set:
        identity_attempts = 0

  # --- Sales ---
  # The name on file comes from the silent lookup and is not confirmed: the sales agents ask or
  # confirm the name before using it (E08, E13). The name and number they take come back as
  # caller_name and contact_mobile so the next specialist does not ask again.
  - TO: Toyota_Sales_Enquiry_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "sales_enquiry"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_name, lead_id, model_of_interest]
      summary: "The caller has a sales enquiry about a Toyota car."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        lead_id: lead_id
        model_of_interest: model_of_interest
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile
      set:
        identity_attempts = 0

  - TO: Toyota_Test_Drive_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "test_drive"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, identity_status, crm_customer_id, customer_name, lead_id, model_of_interest]
      summary: "The caller wants a test drive. A lead and a model of interest are passed when the sales specialist already has them."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        lead_id: lead_id
        model_of_interest: model_of_interest
        caller_name: caller_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile
      set:
        identity_attempts = 0

  # --- Places, and everything else ---
  - TO: Toyota_Locations_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "location_hours"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, caller_name, identity_status, crm_customer_id]
      summary: "The caller asks where a showroom or service centre is, its hours or its phone number."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile
      set:
        identity_attempts = 0

  # No name and no car is passed: the front desk handles the general questions of E05.
  - TO: Toyota_Front_Desk_Agent
    WHEN: intent.category == "general_conversation" OR intent.category == "other_product" OR intent.category == "unknown" OR intent.category == "goodbye"
    CONTEXT:
      pass: [caller_phone, contact_mobile, identity_status, crm_customer_id]
      summary: "General conversation, a product this line does not serve, an unclear request, or the end of the call."
      history:
        mode: last_n
        count: 10
    EXPECT_RETURN: true
    ON_RETURN:
      handler: after_specialist
      map:
        end_call: end_call
      set:
        profile_update_done = false
        identity_attempts = 0

# The front desk says goodbye (or closes after a second abusive message) and returns end_call.
COMPLETE:
  - WHEN: end_call == true

# Last resort only: every planned road to a person goes through Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent.
ESCALATE:
  context_for_human:
    - caller_phone
    - customer_name
    - plate_number
    - conversation_history

  routing:
    queue: "toyota_contact_centre"

# E26: one retry, then a person. Errors go through the handover agent so that its queue check,
# its callback offer and the demo gate apply; only a failed routing step escalates directly.
ON_ERROR:
  routing_error:
    RESPOND: "I'm sorry, I'm having trouble with that just now."
    MESSAGE_KEY: system_trouble
    RETRY: 1
    THEN: ESCALATE with REASON: "The assistant could not complete the request"

  llm_error:
    RETRY: 1
    THEN: HANDOFF
    HANDOFF_TARGET: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent

  timeout_error:
    RETRY: 1
    THEN: HANDOFF
    HANDOFF_TARGET: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent

  tool_error:
    THEN: CONTINUE

  unknown_error:
    RETRY: 0
    THEN: HANDOFF
    HANDOFF_TARGET: Toyota_Human_Handover_Agent
